Title: Market Researcher - Competitive Landscape Analysis for SaaS Digital Measurement Solutions
We are seeking a skilled market researcher to conduct an industry landscape analysis for SaaS B2B Measurement Solutions. Your aim is to investigate the following problem statement: Businesses that have long sales cycles, complex buying journeys, and high transaction values lack consolidated reporting and analytics to attribute customer value back to their marketing efforts. Who in the market is solving this problem? How do they solve this problem? text:
Businesses with long sales cycles and complex buying journeys need a clear way to connect revenue back to marketing, and that’s exactly the problem you’re looking to solve through this competitive landscape analysis.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I can help you map the marketing measurement space with a practical, research-driven approach. In a recent B2B SaaS project, I built embedded customer analytics dashboards in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL so each account could view its own metrics; it rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early.

I’d use that same structured approach here to evaluate dreamdata.io, dealtale.com, factors.ai, Google Analytics, and Adobe Analytics across product offerings, positioning, pricing, reviews, strengths, weaknesses, and whitespace opportunities. I can also turn the findings into a clear report and presentation with actionable recommendations.
